params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Zilean}} generates a storage of {{sti|{{as|experience}}}} over time. When he has enough to level up an allied {{tip|champion}}, he can {{tip|channel}} by {{RMB}}selecting them to split the stored {{sti|{{as|experience}}}} between himself and the ally.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Zilean''' generates {{sti|Experience|{{as|{{pp|2;3.5;5;6;12|1;6;11;16;18}} experience}}}} (does not count towards his own [[Experience (champion)|level up]]) every 5 seconds. ''Time in a Bottle'' is on cooldown when the game starts and becomes disabled when '''Zilean''' and his allied champions have reached their {{tt|maximum level|On Summoner's Rift, level 20 for the champion in the top lane role and 18 for Zilean and all other allies.}}.
params.description2:
When he has stored enough {{as|experience}} to level up an allied {{tip|champion}} to their next level, he can {{tt|select them|Default MB2/right-click}} to {{tip|channel}} for {{fd|1.2}} seconds after a {{fd|0.5}}-second [[cast time]].

The channel is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} and disabled upon entering [[combat status|combat]] with enemy champions or taking damage from {{tip|turret|turrets}}, placing it on a {{sti|10-second cooldown}}. If '''Zilean''' interrupts it himself, it is placed on a 1-second cooldown, increased to 2 if he used a [[basic attack]] against a turret to do so. Additionally, if '''Zilean''' becomes affected by any form of {{tip|crowd control}}, the channel is placed on a 10-second cooldown.
params.description3: A successful channel will grant an equal amount of {{as|experience}} to the ally for them to level up as well as to '''Zilean''', with a combined minimum of 15% of the stored {{as|experience}}.
params.description4: '''''Zilean''' cannot initiate the channel while he is affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}} or a {{tip|lockout}} that disables abilities.''
params.notes:
* ''Time in a Bottle'' marks allied champions with two circles beneath them; the inner one represents how close they are to leveling up, turning golden when able to activate ''Time in a Bottle'' on them.
* The target allied champion is not required to be out of combat to be leveled up by ''Time in a Bottle'' - only '''Zilean''' is.
* '''Zilean''' only consumes the amount of {{sti|{{as|experience}}}} required to level up an allied champion. He retains the excess for later use.
* The target allied champion is not required to be within range of '''Zilean''' for the channel to complete successfully, it will complete regardless of if they move to a far distance.
* The channel from ''Time in a Bottle'' is not interrupted even if the allied champion suddenly levels up. However, no experience will be granted to either player, and the passive will not go on cooldown.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Zilean''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}}:
{{ct|channel|attack=interrupts|cast=interrupts|move=interrupts|items=interrupts,true,,false|consume=true|spells=true, interrupts, interrupts, interrupts, interrupts|interrupts=death, silence}}

blurb.plain: Innate: Zilean generates a storage of experience over time. When he has enough to level up an allied champion, he can channel by ⟦rmb⟧selecting them to split the stored experience between himself and the ally.

description.plain: Innate: Zilean generates 2 / 3.5 / 5 / 6 / 12 (based on level) experience (does not count towards his own level up) every 5 seconds. Time in a Bottle is on cooldown when the game starts and becomes disabled when Zilean and his allied champions have reached their maximum level.

description2.plain: When he has stored enough experience to level up an allied champion to their next level, he can select them to channel for 1.2 seconds after a 0.5-second cast time. The channel is interrupted and disabled upon entering combat with enemy champions or taking damage from turrets, placing it on a 10-second cooldown. If Zilean interrupts it himself, it is placed on a 1-second cooldown, increased to 2 if he used a basic attack against a turret to do so. Additionally, if Zilean becomes affected by any form of crowd control, the channel is placed on a 10-second cooldown.

description3.plain: A successful channel will grant an equal amount of experience to the ally for them to level up as well as to Zilean, with a combined minimum of 15% of the stored experience.

description4.plain: Zilean cannot initiate the channel while he is affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control or a lockout that disables abilities.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Zilean}} throws a ticking time bomb to the target location that will attach upon enemy contact, {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them. It will detonate after a short time or when the attached unit dies, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies hit.
params.blurb2: The bomb will detonate immediately if another bomb attaches to the same target, briefly {{tip|stun|stunning}} enemies hit.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zilean''' throws a ticking time bomb to the target location that briefly grants {{tip|sight}} of its {{tt|surroundings|Cannot grant sight through terrain and can only grant sight into brush when the missile flies through that brush}} as it travels as well as while lingering in the area. The bomb will attach itself to units that move within the epicenter, or those hit directly at the time of the bomb's landing, {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them and their surroundings.
params.description2: {{tt|After 3 seconds|From when the bomb lands}}, or when the attached unit dies, the bomb explodes to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
params.description3: The bomb detonates immediately if another bomb attaches itself to the same unit, {{tip|stun|stunning}} nearby enemies for a duration.
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|350|Explosion radius}}|{{tip|sight|icononly=true}}{{tt|500|Missile sight radius while in flight}}}}
params.notes:
* ''Time Bombs'' landing directly on top of multiple units follow a priority order for whom to attach themselves to.
*# Units already carrying a bomb
*# Enemy champions
*# Allied champions
*# Enemy minions
*# Allied minions
* ''Time Bombs'' are not visible to enemies if they attach to an ally that is {{tip|stealth|stealthed}} and vice versa.
* When ''Time Bomb'' snaps onto an enemy, it  deals 0 {{tip|proc damage}}.
** This triggers [[combat status|in-combat]] effects such as drawing turret aggro and drawing [[Monster#Monster_Behavior|monster aggression]].
** It also triggers {{ri|Sudden Impact}} and applies {{ii|Elixir of Sorcery}}.
** It does not trigger {{ri|Cheap Shot}}, however, as {{tip|proc damage}} doesn't trigger {{ri|Cheap Shot}}.
* '''Zilean''' can detonate an enemy counterpart's ''Time Bomb'' by placing his own on the same unit (the first bomb still deals damage).
* ''Time Bomb'' will be dispelled if the holder takes fatal damage and is saved by {{tip|resurrection}} before it explodes.
* ''Time Bomb'' can deal damage to the enemy holder through {{tip|untargetable|untargetablility}}.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will prevent the application of ''Time Bomb'' and its detonation damage as well as block the {{tip|stun}}, but not its immediate detonation if the target already has a ''Time Bomb'' on them.
* While {{ai|Inherent Glamour|Neeko|disguised}} as a non-champion, {{ci|Neeko}} cannot be affected by ''Time Bomb''.{{bug}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Zilean}} places a protective time rune on himself or the target allied champion for a few seconds.
params.blurb2: If the target would die, they enter {{tip|resurrection}} for a short time, becoming {{tip|invulnerable}}, {{tip|untargetable}}, and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}}. They are {{tip|heal|healed}} afterwards.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zilean''' places a protective time rune on the target allied {{tip|champion}} or himself for 5 seconds.
params.description2: If the target takes {{tip|death|fatal damage}} within the duration, they enter {{tip|resurrection}} for 3 seconds, becoming {{tip|invulnerable}}, {{tip|untargetable}}, and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}}. Afterwards, they revive while being {{tip|heal|healed}}.
params.notes:
* Upon trigger, ''Chronoshift'' places all [[summoner spell]]s that are not already on cooldown on a 3-second {{sti|cooldown}}.
* ''Chronoshift's'' {{tip|untargetability}} does not {{tip|homing projectile destruction|destroy}} in-flight {{tip|projectiles}}.
* ''Chronoshift'' cannot target {{tip|clone|clones}}.
* ''Chronoshift'' takes priority over all other {{tip|resurrection}} effects as well as all {{tip|zombie state}} effects.
* ''Chronoshift'' does not activate if the target is killed by the {{tip|Nexus Obelisk}}.
* ''Chronoshift'' has a {{tip|forgiveness radius}} of 175 units.
* While in resurrection, the target's [[health regeneration]] is set to 0.
* The target's screen will have a white tint.
* The following table refers for interactions while the target is unable to act:
{{ct|attack=false|move=false|cast=false|items=false|consume=false|spells=true,false,false,false,false,false,false|interrupts=death}}
